name: @gebeta/maps-core
description: Core platform-agnostic implementation for Gebeta Maps SDKs

scripts.lint: test -d src && eslint "src/**/*.ts" || echo 'No src directory - skipping lint'
scripts.lint:fix: test -d src && eslint "src/**/*.ts" --fix || echo 'No src directory - skipping lint'
scripts.typecheck: test -d src && tsc --noEmit || echo 'No src directory - skipping typecheck'
scripts.format: test -d src && prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" || echo 'No src directory - skipping format'
scripts.format:check: test -d src && prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" || echo 'No src directory - skipping format check'
